title: NASA's higher-resolution Mars images released to calm the controversy

tellings.quote: that NASA um released those second higher resolution images to sort of quell the the firestorm that had erupted.

plain: NASA released a second, higher-resolution set of images of Cydonia, a region of Mars, to "quell the firestorm" that had broken out over earlier pictures of the area. That is how a guest named Tim Alberino tells it to Michels, without naming a source; on his telling, the new images were as much about calming a public controversy as about showing the ground.
